blocks.tamil_translation: fear Him; and obey me” (he said). “(If you act so,) He will forgive you your sins; and He will give you respite until an appointed term; indeed the term of Allah - when it comes - will not be delayed; if only you knew (this)!” (he also said). He said, “My Rabb, indeed I called my people (towards the right path) night and day.” “But my call increased them in nothing (else) except fleeing” (he also said). “And indeed, every time I called them so that You might forgive them, they put their fingers in their ears; they covered (their faces) with their garments; and they persisted stubbornly (in their disbelief); and they were exceedingly arrogant. Then indeed I called them (towards the right path) aloud. Then indeed I proclaimed (the call) to them openly; and I also did (my preaching) to them secretly in private. Then I said, “Seek forgiveness from your Rabb; indeed He is ever Most Forgiving. (If you do so) He will send rain upon you in continuous showers - and He will help you with wealth and sons (by giving them), make gardens for you, and make rivers for you (flowing in abundance). What is the matter with you? You do not perceive the majesty due to Allah, while He has created you in stages. Do you not see how Allah has created the seven heavens in layers?
